_comment: --cms=none: drop the CMS render package and the Contentful rich-text deps. Their only importers — lib/cms (Contentful provider), components/cms/blockRenderers + DynamicBlockRenderer, and app/layout.tsx — are trimmed or replaced by the no-CMS overlay, so nothing references them after scaffolding. `null` deletes the key (see jsonPatch.ts). The CLI also prunes these three from package-lock.json (CMS_PACKAGES in scaffold.ts) so `npm ci` doesn't reinstall them.
